title: Expose route opportunity reasons in pilot evidence and summaries
author: Worldview Sorter AI editorial review
currentBehavior: Pilot results distinguish not_measured from insufficient_evidence, but do not report why the route lacked an opportunity. Facet and domain result objects have no explicit measurement status.
proposedBehavior: Add route_omission, branch_not_reached, and unavailable_in_instrument reasons computed from exact assigned and branch-skipped evidence units. Preserve existing high-level states and thresholds. Add explicit facet and domain opportunity summaries and explanatory wording. Pin changed execution code in a new engine-source and model release.
rationale: An omitted question, a conditional path not reached, and an instrument-wide one-sided rule are distinct content limitations. None describes the respondent's belief. A response with no usable direction remains insufficient_evidence when the opportunity existed.

philosophicalBasis.proposition: A respondent-facing proposition requires a valid opportunity to encounter direct evidence for the exact target before any directional conclusion can be inferred.
neighboringViews: A respondent who was asked but selected no view
A conditional item not presented because its prerequisite was not met
A theory-choice answer that does not deny a neighboring proposition
nonEntailments: A missing opposing item implies respondent support
A generic philosophical source validates the questionnaire's thresholds
philosophicalBasis.existingGap: The current engine reports one not_measured_content status for route omission, branch ineligibility, and bank-wide directional defects; the public summary attributes all to a frozen route.
philosophicalBasis.scholarlyDisagreement: The exact doctrinal neighbors vary by proposition. The engine records opportunity only; the editorial rule and its linked sources govern the philosophical inference.

sourceClaims.claim: Different cosmopolitan positions distinguish universal moral concern from equal priority in a particular political or aid decision; an omitted discriminator cannot be treated as a respondent's denial of either view.

alternatives: Use one generic not-measured explanation: rejected because a route omission and an instrument-wide one-sided rule call for different repairs.
Infer measurement from the route name: rejected because branch prerequisites and actual assigned revisions determine opportunity.
Change historical result states: rejected because saved releases need byte-identical replay.
respondentImpact: Public summaries can explain why a proposition was unassessed; no directional result or answer mapping changes. Facets and domains can show whether this administration assessed any of their public rules.
historicalCompatibility: Keep model-release-1.2.0 and engine-source-1.0.0 intact. Publish an additive engine-source archive and a new model release. Historical replay selects the archived code.

approvals.note: Reviewed the distinction between an opportunity to assess a proposition and the respondent's answer evidence, including one-sided doctrinal neighbors.
Reviewed assignment, branch-skip, and no-view fixtures; retained old state semantics and planned a new source archive.

release.migration: No raw-response or stored-result migration. Existing snapshots keep their recorded model release; new replays use the new engine-source reference.
